Plugin.Name: Docker Folders
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: docker folders folder group grouping organise organize container tidy collapse fold start order autostart bulk
Plugin.Overview:
Adds folders to the Unraid Docker page.
Group related containers into a folder, fold it away behind a single row that still shows every member's icon, and unfold it to see the full container rows numbered in start order.
A folder's icon opens its commands: start, stop, restart, pause, resume, check for updates, update, force update, and open every WebUI. Each runs across the whole folder, one container at a time, honouring the folder's start order, its delay between starts, and reverse-order stop. Only one job runs at a time. Clicking any icon in a folded folder opens that single container's menu instead.
Folders can fill themselves: give one a name pattern, or label a container docker.folders=<folder>, and matching containers join automatically, including ones created later.
Folder start order drives Unraid's own autostart order rather than shadowing it, so containers come up at boot in the same order the folder uses. Folder icons come from a built-in set, from one of the member containers, or downloaded and stored locally so they still render with no internet.
Editing or deleting a folder never stops, removes or recreates a container; deleting one only removes the grouping and its containers move to "Not in a folder". A "Classic view" switch restores the standard Unraid table at any time, and uninstalling leaves the stock page exactly as it was.
Folder definitions are stored on the flash drive and survive reboots. No core Unraid file is modified.
